parameters.query:
select workflow_id, name, kind, max_silence_hours,
       coalesce(nullif((select value from app_config where key='ops_alert_email'),''), 'honlamchia@gmail.com') as ops_email
from heartbeat_expected where enabled order by name

insert into pipeline_errors (company, phase, node_name, error_msg, resolved) select 'n8n', 'heartbeat', $1, $2, false where not exists (select 1 from pipeline_errors where phase = 'heartbeat' and node_name = $1 and occurred_at::date = current_date) returning id
